items.t: Adaptive cruise may not brake as expected (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Tire tread may separate on 21-inch tires (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer

items.t: Pedestrian warning sound may be too quiet (recall)
items.job: Free recall repair at a Chevrolet dealer
Battery inspection; pack replacement if GM approves
items.note: 1.0 hour is the GM inspection time. A replacement pack is covered by the 8-year/100,000-mile EV battery warranty.

items.t: Service High Voltage message with dead 12-volt battery
items.job: Battery control module software update and reset
items.note: Hours are GM warranty labor times. Covered by GM warranty on most cars; a 12-volt battery may need recharging.

items.t: Service High Voltage warning from battery software codes
items.job: Battery control module programming and reset
items.note: Hours combine GM labor times for battery data retrieval, programming and reset. Normally covered by warranty.

items.t: No cabin heat with Service High Voltage warning
items.note: Software fix under warranty; a failed thermal system part would cost more but is covered by the EV component warranty.

items.t: Unable to charge or DC fast charging unavailable
items.job: Diagnose code P2980 and update software
items.note: 1.0 hour is GM labor time. A real insulation fault needs further repair.

items.t: Touchscreen or gauge display goes black or reboots
items.job: Radio software update or reset, check display cables
items.note: GM says not to replace the radio for most of these concerns.

items.t: False low 12-volt battery alerts from OnStar
items.note: No repair beyond the software; normally done free under warranty.
